body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Until your next turn, detect moving creatures within 2 units of the point through ordinary concealment, but not through solid walls. Reveal their spaces to willing allies within 3 units of you.

surges.html: Increase the detection radius by 1 unit.
One detected enemy loses its ordinary concealment benefit against the next attack targeting it until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Rite - Divination
rider.html: Rite, 2 Echoes: anchor the point. Trigger: a detected enemy begins an Action within 2 units. Echo: yourself or a willing ally within 3 units gains +1 Defense against that Action.
